help.blank: I ordered a salad, ___ I got a burger.

expressions.pattern: ^i ordered (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,5}) (?:but|and) (?:i got|i received|you gave me|this is|it is|its) (?<y>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,5})$

help.blank: Would it be ___ to change it?

expressions.pattern: ^(?:would it be possible|is it possible|would you be able) to (?![a-z]*[^e]ed\b)(?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,8})$|^could you possibly (?!to )(?![a-z]*[^e]ed\b)(?<y>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,8})$
expressions.accept_note: ‘Can you …?’는 뜻 전달(부분, 덜 정중함). possibly·to 뒤가 -ed 형태면 부분.

is it possible to get a new one
partial: Could you possibly to change it
no: Would it be possible change it
